title: MM Hunter / Frost Mage / Disc vs Thug
summary: Stun and trap into the cast — never open on one. Their Priest holds five and no escape.

sections.title: Nothing here is cast from a standing start
sections.body: Counts: Rogue 6, Hunter 6, Priest 5. Their Priest is the target on count and because he has no mobility and no interrupt. But this comp's whole difficulty is that a Rogue and a Hunter will never let you free-cast: every chain below opens on an instant, and the cast goes inside a stun that has already landed.

sections.title: Opener — instant, then trap, then the cast

steps.note: 40s stun. Instant — this is what buys the trap.
25s. On a second target while the stun holds.
Now it lands, because nobody is free to stop it.
90s. The slowest term; the cadence is this.
60s. Every second Trueshot, aligned not scattered.
180s, 8s, 2 charges. Expect it twice in a game.
20s. Constant, so it is not a real forcing target.
6s silence. Your Mage and Priest both cast; he knows.
120s. It arrives during your go, not before it.
25s. The same plan you are running, back at you.
